samples.description: First random firm-level exploratory subsample from the final Compustat firm-year sample; all eligible years for sampled GVKEYs are retained. The data contain current earnings and CFO, volatility quintiles, and separate one- through five-year outcomes. The five-year sum requires all five future leads.

assumptions: The paper does not report the principal regression estimator or standard-error correction; native OLS with conventional standard errors and an intercept is used.

The paper randomizes firms; the original seed is unavailable, so half of distinct GVKEYs are selected with fixed seed 20261102 and all eligible firm-years retained. The published 11,061/11,052 row counts are comparison benchmarks, not imposed sizes.
Volatility quintiles are pooled across the exploratory sample; equal-volatility tie handling follows PROC RANK defaults.

The $100 million assets screen uses provider-documented Xpressfeed daily quotes at each row own DATADATE: USD identity, GBP-to-USD for GBP, and GBP-to-source followed by GBP-to-USD for other currencies. Only positive unique quotes are used; each used leg keeps its raw EXRATTPD provenance, including blank or mixed descriptors. Current/prior average-assets ratios require both known CURCD values to agree. Future scaled earnings are internally valid dimensionless ratios and are not screened against the current-year currency.

limitations: The paper’s Compustat file vintage and original firm-level random split seed are unavailable. The current local sample has 26,335 final firm-years versus 22,113 reported, and the fixed-seed firm-level exploratory split has 13,364 firm-years versus 11,061 reported. These published counts are not forced, and the residual differences are unresolved.

The paper does not specify the principal OLS covariance correction; conventional OLS standard errors are used. Native t-tests are two-sided; the reported table states p<0.001 but does not state sidedness.
The paper does not specify the percentile implementation or how tied volatility values are assigned to quintiles; pooled cutoffs and PROC RANK defaults are used.
Table 2 Panel B does not report per-quintile N. Horizon-specific regression Ns are exported for comparison; the published Table 3 and Table 4 counts are the available checks.

Supporting adjusted-R-squared tests use 1,000 row-level pseudo-quintile assignments over the local exploratory sample with a fixed seed; the paper describes this row-level unit but its sample has 11,061 observations. The original simulation seed is unreported. Both one-sided and two-sided empirical tails are logged; the final zero-hit tail estimate is limited by 1,000 repetitions.

The current local COMP.FUNDA currency mix and exact own-DATADATE daily FX coverage are audited in A3. CAD threshold movements versus A2 CURRTR are reported by year; source vintage and original split seed remain unknown. Current/prior ratios with missing or incompatible currency codes are unavailable, while currency changes between separate valid lead ratios are allowed.
